e.body:
**Institut des Actuaires（法国精算师协会）** 是**法国的精算专业团体**，与同轮收录的 [[acpr]] 一起补上**法国**这一空白市场（实测池内法国相关条目为 0）。可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 144.8KB；**技术委员会与工作组页 `/contribuer-a-l-institut/commissions-techniques-et-groupes-de-travail-1999` 72.5KB**（页内含**加入某个技术委员会、加入某个工作组**的入口）；培养侧实测到的路径包括 **`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-etudiants/formations-initiales-491`（初始培养）**、**`…/parcours-497`（学习路径）**、**`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-professionnels/master-actuariat-cnam-34`（CNAM 精算硕士）**、**`…/certificat-d-expertise-actuarielle-irm-35`（IRM 精算专家证书）**，以及针对培训机构开放的「申报培训」入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上法国的专业团体与资格路径**——池内该类条目已覆盖英国（[[ifoa]]）、英联邦多国（[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[assa]]）、中国（[[china-actuarial-association]]）与考试类（[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]），**法国此前为零**；**② 有两点对学生的实际价值**——**技术委员会与工作组**（commissions techniques et groupes de travail）**自带加入入口**，这是**把课程作业升级为行业参与**的可操作路径之一（与池内 [[dav-ai-professional-profile]] 一类「专业身份与 CPD」条目同类）；**③ 法语区的学术与教材侧**可与 [[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-association]]、[[actuarial-open-book]]、[[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] 并读；**④ 监管配对**见 [[acpr]]，跨市场职业路径对照可看 [[seddk]]（土耳其）、[[fsca]]/[[assa]]（南非）、[[asf-romania]]（罗马尼亚）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 站点以法语为主**（本次未核实英文版），**语言门槛真实存在**；**②** 本次核实到**页面存在与结构**（含技术委员会/工作组与培养路径的具体路径），**但未逐页打开培养页或任何文件**，因此**不能确认课程内容、费用与资格要求**；**③** 「IRM 精算专家证书」等名称**按页面路径原文记录**，**其认证条件与互认关系未核实**；**④** 本站为**专业团体站点，不含市场统计数据**（法国监管与机构数据见 [[acpr]]）。**核实说明**：首页（144.8KB）与技术委员会/工作组页（72.5KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取链接结构；其余路径在首页导航中实测可见；**未打开个别培养页或文件**。
e.body_en:
**Institut des Actuaires** is **France’s actuarial professional body**, and together with [[acpr]] (also added this round) it fills the **France** gap (a measured search found zero France-related entries). Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 144.8KB; the **technical commissions and working groups page `/contribuer-a-l-institut/commissions-techniques-et-groupes-de-travail-1999`** at 72.5KB (with entries for **joining a technical commission** and **joining a working group**); education paths observed include **`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-etudiants/formations-initiales-491` (initial training)**, **`…/parcours-497` (study pathway)**, **`/devenir-actuaire/formations-pour-professionnels/master-actuariat-cnam-34` (the CNAM actuarial master’s)** and **`…/certificat-d-expertise-actuarielle-irm-35` (the IRM actuarial expertise certificate)**, plus a training-declaration entry for course providers.

For RIAA: **① it adds France’s professional body and qualification pathway** — such entries already cover the UK ([[ifoa]]), several Commonwealth bodies ([[actuaries-institute]], [[singapore-actuarial-society]], [[assa]]), China ([[china-actuarial-association]]) and the exam-prep layer ([[actuarial-exam-database]], [[open-exam-prep]]), while **France was at zero**; **② two things are practically useful to students** — the **technical commissions and working groups** come with **their own join entries**, one of the actionable routes from coursework into行业 participation (kin to professional-identity and CPD entries such as [[dav-ai-professional-profile]]); **③ the francophone academic and textbook side** pairs with [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[geneva-association]], [[actuarial-open-book]] and [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]; **④ regulatory pairing** is [[acpr]], and cross-market career-path comparisons are [[seddk]] (Turkey), [[fsca]]/[[assa]] (South Africa) and [[asf-romania]] (Romania).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the site is mainly in French** (no English version was verified here), so **a real language barrier exists**; **②** this check verified **page existence and structure** (including the specific commission/working-group and training paths) **but opened no training page or file**, so **course content, fees and qualification requirements cannot be confirmed**; **③** names such as the "IRM actuarial expertise certificate" are **recorded as written in the site paths**, and **their certification conditions and mutual recognition were not verified**; **④** this is a **professional body site with no market statistics** (French supervisory and institution data is in [[acpr]]). **Verification note**: the homepage (144.8KB) and the commissions/working-groups page (72.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their link structure read; the remaining paths were observed in the homepage navigation; **no individual training page or file was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**Institut des Actuaires（法國精算師協會）** 是**法國的精算專業團體**，與同輪 [[acpr]] 一起補上**法國**空白市場。可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 144.8KB；**技術委員會與工作組頁 72.5KB**（含**加入技術委員會、加入工作組**入口）；培養側路徑實測可見 **初始培養**、**學習路徑**、**CNAM 精算碩士**、**IRM 精算專家證書**，以及面向培訓機構的申報入口。

對 RIAA：**① 補上法國專業團體與資格路徑**——同類條目已覆蓋英國（[[ifoa]]）、英聯邦多國（[[actuaries-institute]]、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]、[[assa]]）、中國（[[china-actuarial-association]]）與考試類（[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[open-exam-prep]]），**法國此前為零**；**② 技術委員會與工作組自帶加入入口**，是**把課程作業升級為行業參與**的可操作路徑之一；**③ 法語區學術側**可並讀 [[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-association]]、[[actuarial-open-book]]、[[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]；**④ 監管配對**見 [[acpr]]，跨市場職業路徑見 [[seddk]]、[[fsca]]、[[assa]]、[[asf-romania]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 站點以法語為主**（未核實英文版）；**②** 本次核實到**頁面存在與結構**，**但未逐頁打開培養頁或任何文件**；**③** 「IRM 精算專家證書」等名稱**按頁面路徑原文記錄**，**認證條件與互認關係未核實**；**④** 本站為**專業團體站點，不含市場統計**（法國監管數據見 [[acpr]]）。**核實說明**：首頁與技術委員會/工作組頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開個別培養頁或文件**。
